Between the calls edi steps back one 0x160 record: at or above [0x00891500] (pit start, jb at 0x0043ede1) it is clamped to stay >= [0x00891500] (0x0043ede9..0x0043edf1), below it it wraps forward by [0x00866ec4] when it drops under [0x00891504] (the first lap record; jae at 0x0043ee05). Domain: record-aligned pointers into the array at 0x008943a0 (pit start 0..26, lap start 0..4) and a wrap distance of 1..20 records; enumerating every combination gives visited records 0..26 only (k = 0 with lap start 0 wraps to a valid record because the distance is >= 1), so words +0 and +0x18 of exactly those 27 records are unconstrained i16. Unrelated fixed globals and a random edi buffer never reached the >= and wrap paths.
